name: HolyMind Quiet Current — Complete Journey

features.continuity: The approved quiet field and directional filament now continue to the footer. One existing audio instrument; no extra track, oscillator bank or chime at each chapter boundary.
features.scene_material: Deterministic, reversible blends. Open skill exploration, restrained gallery, structured services, softer About and gentle Contact/Footer. Scene changes smooth parameters on existing nodes, never restart sources.
features.reading: Open dialogs/navigation lower the field and suppress page-scroll current. Visible optional reading disclosures soften the field. Closing them restores the same running instrument.
features.dynamic_layout: Gallery expansion, filtering, search, disclosures, fonts and orientation remeasure all downstream scene coordinates. Layout/navigation changes do not create scroll swooshes.
features.preserved: Fourteen Electric v12 tap presets, all visual/motion/control modules, original images, 34 skills, mobile-only brain-first layout, pinned 0–100–0 assembly and ten reversible visual bridges.
features.control: Persistent master sound mute/volume and independent Background ambience / Scroll response controls. Motion remains always active independently of sound.
features.lifecycle: No playback or AudioContext until an explicit sound/brain gesture; hidden/interrupted audio stops. Return requires a fresh gesture, with no missed-event replay.
features.studio: All eleven chapters selectable on the real live page; Taps only / Field + taps / Full mix comparisons and five forty-second production-graph audio previews at the same master gain.

native_touch_method: Chromium mobile emulation with DevTools native touch input. Each swipe is sampled during motion; at least three samples must meet unchanged input/direction/peak/output thresholds.

approved_v13_sound_comparison.method: Same OfflineAudioContext, original v13 graph vs v14 defaults, approved Hero-to-Assembly parameter score

limitations.preview_method: Scripted OfflineAudioContext renders of the production route and graph, not microphone recordings.
